records.note: Work Up: Use the ladder close to the little pond on the west side, then search the roof. Bring Rock Smash for the obstacle.
records.limits: Roof and ladder corroborated; exact pixel unknown.

records.note: Swift: Cross towards the central island and look beside the tree near the water.
records.limits: Original tree-and-lake clue preserved; no exact tree verified.

records.note: Aerial Ace: Look at the top of the western monument, rather than searching at street level.
records.limits: Tower target corroborated; climbing sequence remains unverified.

records.note: Fire Spin: Go to the southern cemetery monument and burn the brambles behind it with Ember or another suitable Fire move.
records.limits: Mausoleum and brambles corroborated; exact point unknown.

records.note: Bullet Seed: Take the northwestern stairs down to the canal passage and climb the ladder to the rooftops. Search the southern roof in the Bleu Sector 1 area.
records.limits: Lower passage and roof corroborated; precise entrance and ladder are not mapped.

records.note: Water Pulse: Ride the zone Holovator up to the buildings and follow the rooftop route towards the southern building. Search the roof terrace near Swablu.
records.limits: Sources give different travel bearings from the lift. Destination is corroborated, exact intermediate route and lift identity are not.

records.note: Dazzling Gleam: Search around the central obelisk and clear the nearby brambles with Ember.
records.limits: Central monument corroborated; no new pin.

records.note: Rock Tomb: Search the open ground around the centre of the plaza.
records.limits: Central area corroborated; no exact ball location.

records.note: Power-Up Punch: Enter from near Café Slalom. Clear the rocks towards the northeast and climb the ladder. Search the roof of the eastern building complex, towards its southern side.
records.limits: Rooftop destination corroborated; Japanese source describes access route, not physically checked.

records.note: Night Slash: Use the ladder on the southeastern side and travel west over the roofs. Look for the sludge obstruction. Try a Water attack; another guide recommends Confusion.
records.limits: Water versus Confusion recommendations differ; no exclusive move requirement or exact roof geometry asserted.

records.note: Psychic: Search the northern area near Alpha Slowbro and burn the brambles with Ember or another suitable Fire move.
records.limits: Alpha and northern brambles corroborated; no exact bush verified.

records.note: Ice Beam: Go to the battle court and check its centre. Bring Rock Smash for the obstacle.
records.limits: Court location corroborated; exact rock not mapped.

records.note: X-Scissor: Search the brambles along the zone paths near Weepinbell, and use Ember to clear them. Watch for the Alpha Weepinbell.
records.limits: Sources vary on directional wording. Japanese general TM list instead reports a hotel NPC; multiple other sources and the saved ledger support the Wild Zone 13 pickup. Do not assert an NPC alternative or precise bearing.

records.note: Discharge: Check behind the small building at the southeastern corner. Break the rocks with Rock Smash to reach the item.
records.limits: Southeastern rock obstruction corroborated.

records.note: Earth Power: Complete Side Mission 080, A Shocking Territorial Dispute, to activate the lift southwest of Wild Zone 15. It becomes available during Main Mission 26. Ride up, clear the web, then follow the elevated route into the zone and use Roto-Glide where needed.
records.limits: Unlock and elevated route corroborated. Exact device identity and roof crossing not physically checked.

records.note: Liquidation: Search the raised grassy garden near Alpha Ampharos, on the northern side of the zone.
records.limits: Garden and Alpha landmark corroborated; exact elevation not measured.

records.note: Flamethrower: Look for the ladder giving access to the zone roof, then search the rooftop edge near the chimney. The exact ladder approach is not yet mapped.
records.limits: Rooftop corroborated; no exact entrance bearing asserted.

records.note: Stone Edge: Exit through the southwest gate, climb the nearby ladder and scaffolding, and re-enter at roof level. Cross to the far roof, line up with the item on the lower scaffold, then roll and Roto-Glide across.
records.limits: Independent written descriptions support the traversal. External source-space XY is not a native Atlas coordinate.

records.note: Hurricane: Check the northern path between the hedges. Clear the brambles with Ember to reach the ball.
records.limits: Hedge and bramble cues corroborated.

records.note: Draco Meteor: After unlocking the postgame Wild Zone 20, check the northwestern area behind the shipping container.
records.limits: Written location only. Keep separate from random hidden-item outcomes.
